notes: Five Fluid starting palettes. Image extraction uses visible pixels in a bounded local sample; text tokens choose the highest-contrast light/dark foreground. AA means at least 4.5:1 for normal text. All uploads stay local.

name: Texture Lab
description: Paper, grain, halftone, contour and print textures for any surface.

props: Optional callback receives the current export functions; receives null on unmount.

notes: All five texture treatments are generated locally and deterministically. SVG/CSS contain their complete artwork. PNG is rendered at the chosen square resolution. Paper uses an inline SVG turbulence filter; no external assets.

name: Hero Composer

hint: Edit the words and layout; download a working offline page or a 1440 × 900 PNG.
props: Optional callback receives the current export functions; receives null on unmount.

notes: HTML includes semantic text, an accessible link, artwork, uploads and current settings. It works offline and has a mobile layout. PNG is a still composition. Image uploads are normalized to 2048 px; transparent logos are preferred. Unsafe link protocols fall back to #details.

name: Logo Motion Studio
description: Living chrome, ink and grain inside your wordmark or transparent logo.
hint: Type a word or upload a transparent image. Take a PNG still and a real animated offline HTML embed.
props: Pause the canvas animation. Hidden tabs, offscreen previews and reduced motion also pause it.
Change to restart the material animation.
Current PNG/HTML/JSON functions; null on unmount.
Initial primary artwork/ink/card colour; shared palette compatible.
Initial secondary artwork/paper/focus colour; shared palette compatible.
notes: The current 768 × 432 frame exports as PNG, with optional transparency. HTML embeds the chosen material and mask and animates them with CSS, including pause and reduced-motion controls. It is an animated interpretation of the canvas material, not a video. SVG uploads accept simple local paths/shapes/gradients only; opaque images make rectangular masks.

notes: React and CSS downloads work together; HTML includes everything. IntersectionObserver entrances use the scroll region; all observers/listeners are released on unmount. Reduced motion, hidden tabs and paused React props reveal all content without transitions. No scroll blocking or network calls.
